title: CPU Optimizations (Library of Ruina)
description: CPU savings for the game's per-frame work. The loop fix removes a pointless loop in the Unity binding that copies native GetComponents results into a managed List: after the results are copied, the loop walked every unused slot up to the list's capacity and discarded the result, wasting CPU on every call (about 10% of main-thread samples, and 26% in late frames, in a Library of Ruina 1.0.3 capture). Two optional sub-settings cut more per-frame work: CharacterSpriteMaskController.Update (about 4.5% of main-thread samples) can sync its masks every other frame, and the input module's mouse processing (about 4.9%) can be skipped while the touchscreen pointer is idle. For Library of Ruina 1.0.3.

launcher.label: CPU Optimizations
launcher.note: Removes wasted CPU work the game does every frame, mainly while the UI rebuilds. Frees up processing power for smoother performance and lower heat.

settings.label: Throttle sprite mask updates
settings.note: Character sprite masks re-check their sprite renderer every frame. This does it every other frame, so a mask can follow a character's visibility one frame late.

settings.label: Skip idle pointer updates
settings.note: Skips the per-frame UI raycast while the touchscreen pointer is not moving or pressed, and still refreshes it about every 6 frames. Touchscreen Mode only.

aeea627ddbd1214764dfef5f965e94a2.reason: CharacterSpriteMaskController.Update, just after mov w20, wzr that starts the enable-sync loop (every path into the loop passes it): x19 = the controller; the host writes w20 = 0x7fffffff to skip the loop on a throttled frame

LOR_InputModule.Process, after ldr x9 of the BaseInput.mousePresent virtual and before its blr: the host may swap x9 for a filter that returns false while the touchscreen pointer is idle, which skips ProcessMouseEvent
